bio.text: Suzanne "Suz" Seymour of Highgate is an independent candidate for Vermont's U.S. House seat in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In Vermont Public's candidate guide, where answers appear as submitted, Seymour lists an age of 64 and an occupation of proprietor and massage therapist.
